# 2nd Wave Laundry Services

> Laundry and garment-care business in Ghana, trading as 2nd Wave Laundry Services (short form: 2nd Wave Laundry). Tagline: A Redefined Laundry Experience.

## Facts

- Branches: Ashaiman–Atadeka (main branch, 059 522 4280), Katamanso No. 1 (059 814 8620), Newland Katamanso (024 614 4412).
- Main branch hours: Monday–Saturday 7am–8pm; Sunday 9am–7:30pm. Katamanso branches: 7am–8pm.
- Pickup and delivery: requests are submitted online and confirmed by the team; pickup operates seven days a week from 7am to 5pm.
- Services: wash, ironing and fold; wash and fold only; ironing; stain treatment; duvet and bedding cleaning; curtain cleaning; suit cleaning; shoe care; express/same-day laundry; commercial laundry enquiries.
- Walk-ins and drop-offs are welcome at all three branches.
- Fees and timing are confirmed with the team; submitting a request does not confirm a booking.
- Contact: 059 522 4280 (+233 59 522 4280), support@2ndwavelaundry.com.
